packageRules.description: kopf 1.39+ requires python>=3.10; ceph base image ships python3-cephfs only for system python 3.9. Unpin when ceph base bumps to a newer Stream.
Keep external-dns out of group:allNonMajor so its stricter automerge policy never blocks the shared non-major PR.

external-dns minor bumps carry breaking changes: v0.22.0 dropped the alpha annotation prefix with no fallback and deleted every managed record on first sync (2026-09-18). Patch updates automerge; minor/major need a human. Note upstream kustomize pins the image one tag behind the ref (ref vX.Y.0 ships binary vX.Y-1.0).
